GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.

2. When practising Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.

4. When practising Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing.

5. When practising Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.

6. When practising Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.

7. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Haus
   C. Wasser
   D. Buch

8. When practising Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.

9. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.

11. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Good day / hello
   C. Thank you
   D. Please

12. When practising Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 5.4.5 Verbs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.6 Listening for details and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.6 Reading comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.3.1 Descriptive writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 6.4.6 Adjectives: Comparative and Superlative and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
